map.Disease Activity Score 28 joints，评估类风湿关节: Disease Activity Score 28 joints, assesses rheumatoid arthritis (RA) disease activity and treatment response
map.DAS28（ESR）= 0.56 × √压痛关节数 + 0.28 × √肿胀关节: DAS28 (ESR) = 0.56 x sqrt(tender joint count) + 0.28 x sqrt(swollen joint count) + 0.70 x ln(ESR) + 0.014 x patient global health; DAS28 (CRP) = 0.56 x sqrt(tender count) + 0.28 x sqrt(swollen count) + 0.36 x ln(CRP + 1) + 0.014 x global score + 0.96; <2.6 remission, 2.6-3.2 low, 3.2-5.1 moderate, >5.1 high.
map.提示：DAS28是RA治疗达标(T2T)的核心指标，目标为DAS28<2.6(缓: Note: DAS28 is the core T2T (treat-to-target) indicator for RA, target DAS28<2.6 (remission) or <3.2 (low activity). ESR and CRP formulas differ slightly; DAS28-CRP is usually slightly lower than DAS28-ESR. Exclude infection etc. affecting inflammatory markers when assessing. For clinical reference only.
map.ESR 版：压痛关节 TJC=6、肿胀 SJC=8、ESR 40、GH 60 →: ESR version: TJC=6, SJC=8, ESR 40, GH 60 -> DAS28=0.56 sqrt6+0.28 sqrt8+0.70 ln40+0.014x60+0.96 approx 1.37+0.79+2.58+0.84+0.96=6.54, high activity, needs intensification.
map.TJC=2、SJC=1、ESR 18、GH 30 → 约 2.6，低活动/缓解附: TJC=2, SJC=1, ESR 18, GH 30 -> about 2.6, near low activity/remission, maintain and monitor.
<=2.6 remission (ESR version), >5.1 high, 3.2-5.1 moderate, 2.6-3.2 low; CRP version thresholds slightly differ.
map.28 个指定关节（肘腕以下+肩膝），TJC/SJC 由查体计，GH 为 0–10: 28 designated joints (below elbow/wrist + shoulder/knee); TJC/SJC by exam, GH is 0-100 visual analog.
map.关于「类风湿(DAS28)活动度评估器」: About the Rheumatoid Arthritis (DAS28) Activity Assessor
map.类风湿关节炎DAS28疾病活动度评估器，基于28关节压痛数、肿胀数、ESR/CR: Rheumatoid arthritis DAS28 activity assessor, computes DAS28 by 28-joint tender/swollen counts, ESR/CRP and patient global assessment. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
